_comment: Copy to pipeline.json (or point PIPELINE_CONFIG at it) to override the
defaults in pipeline/config.py. Every key is optional — anything omitted
keeps its built-in value, and dicts are merged rather than replaced, so
listing one vocabulary_boost entry does not drop the others.
Precedence: config.py < this file < pipeline.scoring_weight table < CLI flags.
Values below are the shipped defaults, shown for reference.
_restrict_domains_comment: A hard allow-list: nothing outside these domains can be returned, by any
stage. Empty (the default) means no restriction. This is the persistent
form of the --domain flag; `./pipeline.sh domains` lists the valid names.
Unlike eligible_domains below, it is never relaxed — not by Stage 0's
inferred hint and not by the Stage 6.4 retry.
